name: gleap-us
description: Work your Gleap support queue from Codex: triage tickets, draft replies, and fix or answer tickets with your plan and progress live in Gleap. For workspaces hosted in the US.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to your Gleap workspace (US region): triage the inbox, draft replies, and fix or answer tickets. For sessions started from Gleap, hooks mirror your plan and your last message to the Gleap coding session.
